fmiModelDescription.description: Pennes bioheat thermal ablation plant model on a 16 x 16 x 16 lattice (SurgiTwin-RTA plan task 2.7 slice 1, SRS FR-MS-007)
fmiModelDescription.author: Seth Nenninger

Float64.name: rho
Float64.description: Liver tissue density (IT'IS, Hasgall et al. 2018, as reproduced in Vicentini et al. 2024 Table S1)

Float64.name: c
Float64.description: Liver tissue specific heat (IT'IS, Hasgall et al. 2018, as reproduced in Vicentini et al. 2024 Table S1)

Float64.name: k
Float64.description: Liver thermal conductivity (IT'IS, Hasgall et al. 2018, as reproduced in Vicentini et al. 2024 Table S1)

Float64.name: w_b
Float64.description: Liver blood perfusion rate (IT'IS, Hasgall et al. 2018, as reproduced in Vicentini et al. 2024 Table S1)

Float64.name: c_b
Float64.description: Blood specific heat (IT'IS, Hasgall et al. 2018; value to be confirmed against the IT'IS database download)

Float64.name: Q_met
Float64.description: Liver metabolic heat generation (IT'IS, Hasgall et al. 2018, as reproduced in Vicentini et al. 2024 Table S1)

Float64.name: r_app
Float64.description: Radius of the spherical ablation deposition centered on the lattice center

Float64.name: P_abl
Float64.description: Applicator power deposited uniformly in the ablation sphere

Float64.name: h_bc
Float64.description: Convective heat transfer coefficient on all six lattice faces (0 is a zero-flux boundary)

Float64.name: T_env
Float64.description: Ambient temperature for the convective face term

Float64.name: T_max
Float64.description: Maximum lattice temperature at the current FMU time

Float64.name: T_mean
Float64.description: Mean lattice temperature at the current FMU time

Float64.name: V60
Float64.description: Volume of cells at or above 60 degrees Celsius at the current FMU time

Float64.name: V_lesion
Float64.description: Cumulative lesion volume: cells with CEM43 at or above 240 min (monotone)
